title: The 512th Day
desc: Complete a full run of the MPR General Session, regardless of the outcome.

title: The Caretaker No More
desc: Win the MPR General Session and retain the presidency on any difficulty.

title: A Full Term Secured
desc: Defy history and win the MPR General Session on Historical difficulty.

title: Khatam!
desc: Win the MPR General Session on every standard difficulty: Easy, Medium, High and Historical. Like finishing the whole book cover to cover.

title: Voice of the People
desc: Reach the peak of Popularity ('$tier.pop.tolerated$') on Medium difficulty or above.

title: Cendana Delenda Est
desc: Completely eradicate Cendana Influence on Medium difficulty or above.

title: The Unholy Compromise
desc: Win over Megawati's PDI-P completely on Medium difficulty or above.

title: President Habibie's response is, as always, more austerity.
desc: Please the IMF by eliminating fuel and power subsidies, dismantling BULOG, and liquidating insolvent banks while reaching maximum International Standing with Economic Health and Popularity in ruins (Medium+).

title: Brüning Impressed.
desc: Survive the MPR General Session having enacted all three IMF mandates, reached maximum International Standing, and tanked Economic Health and Popularity. (Any Difficulty)

title: A New Mandate
desc: Win the MPR General Session with an overwhelming landslide (450+ votes).

title: Comfortable Majority
desc: Win the MPR General Session with a comfortable majority (380+ votes).

title: By the Skin of Your Teeth
desc: Survive the MPR General Session in a narrow upset.

title: A Valiant Effort
desc: Lose the presidency by a razor-thin margin.

title: The End of an Era
desc: Suffer a decisive defeat in the MPR General Session.

title: Total Repudiation
desc: Lose the MPR General Session in an overwhelming landslide against you (Under 200 votes).

title: Mr. Crack Never Cracks
desc: Let overall Government Stability fall into UNSTABLE or COLLAPSING, then engineer a structural recovery and win the MPR General Session.

title: Aman Terkendali™
desc: Reach the top National Stability tier ('$tier.stab.uneasy_calm$') on Medium difficulty or above. Everything is secure and under control, as the saying went. Please do not look under the carpet.

title: Cleared for Takeoff, Gatotkaca
desc: Protect BPPT/IPTN research funding AND champion the N-250 Gatotkaca turboprop budget line, then win the MPR General Session.

title: "Halo, Andi? Apa Kabar?"
desc: Uphold the October 11 SP3 order terminating the Suharto corruption investigation while Cendana Influence remains deeply $tier.cendana.entrenched$ or $tier.cendana.untouchable$.

title: Et Tu, Akbar?
desc: Lose the MPR General Session despite holding '$mood.golkar_habibie.ride_or_die$' loyalty with your Golkar Loyalists because Akbar Tandjung's Golkar faction abandoned you.

title: Honorably Discharged
desc: Lose the MPR General Session while overall Government Stability is $gov.stable$ or $gov.secure$.

title: 546 Billion Reasons Why
desc: Blow the lid off Bank Bali. Freeze EGP's accounts, grant PwC unrestricted access, hand the unredacted files to PDI-P's Pansus, and declassify the full audit.

title: Who's Folding Their Arms Now, Michel?
desc: Resurrect Steve Hanke's Currency Board Scheme, defy the IMF's Bank Bali ultimatum, and still finish the game with Economic Health at '$tier.econ.stagnant$' or better.

title: Debts can wait
desc: Win the MPR General Session with Economic Health in '$tier.econ.bankruptcy$'.

title: Persona Non Grata, Mr. President
desc: Win the MPR General Session with International Standing in '$tier.intl.pariah_state$'.

title: The Soap Opera Villain Wins
desc: Win the MPR General Session with Popularity in '$tier.pop.universally_hated$'.

title: A Farewell to Dwifungsi
desc: Separate POLRI from ABRI, expand Komnas HAM's authority over the military, and still win the MPR vote.

title: Nobel Laureate in Spirit
desc: Honor the August 30 East Timor referendum at every turn, invite UN peacekeepers on September 12, and still win the MPR General Session.

title: 355 to 322: Historical Déjà Vu
desc: Lose the MPR General Session with almost the exact tally of Habibie's real-life 322–355 rejection on the night of October 19–20, 1999.

title: Those Who Stayed Silent
desc: Lose the MPR General Session with 330 to 350 votes in favor, where blank ballots and absent delegates, not the 'no' votes, kept you from the 351 you needed.

title: Bah! Wait, That's Gus Dur's Music!
desc: Help Amien Rais become MPR Speaker, cultivate a '$mood.poros_tengah_merged.leaning_toward_habibie$' stance (or better) with the Central Axis, and still lose the Accountability Vote.

title: "Piye Kabare? Enak Jamanku Toh?"
desc: Win the MPR General Session with Cendana Influence nearly $tier.cendana.untouchable$ and Reformasi Credibility reduced to '$tier.ref.authoritarian$' or '$tier.ref.new_order_crony$'.

title: Gliding on Empty
desc: Enter the MPR General Session with zero Political Capital remaining and win the presidency anyway.

title: The Couch Potato President
desc: Win the MPR General Session without enacting a single Extraordinary Decree. Governing is tiring, sometimes, the best policy is to lie down.

title: Umbrella Before the Rain
desc: Reach the MPR General Session with Political Capital at the maximum (100).

title: Habibi, Ya Habibi!
desc: Win the MPR General Session with overwhelming support across the Central Axis, Utusan Golongan, and the Minor Parties.

title: Reformasi Total, Bung!
desc: Enact all seven pillars of reform. The anti-corruption law, civil service neutrality, direct presidential elections, the Suharto asset tribunal, the political prisoner release, Komnas HAM's new powers and broadcast liberalization.

title: The Center Holds
desc: Win the MPR General Session with a majority of delegates backing you in both Golkar wings, Utusan Daerah, Utusan Golongan, the Minor Parties and TNI.

title: LION of reformasi
desc: Win the MPR General Session with Reformasi Credibility at its highest tier and Cendana Influence reduced to $tier.cendana.weakened$ or $tier.cendana.dormant$.

title: Orde Baru Jilid II
desc: Enact both 'Supersemar II' and the Jalan Cendana Restoration Pact, and survive the MPR General Session.

title: The Empire Strikes Beringin
desc: Pass the Kamra militia bill, reinstate SIUPP press censorship, purge Utusan Golongan and mobilize the Pam Swakarsa. A long time ago, in a regime not so far away...

title: SIUPP Is Back, Baby
desc: Reinstate SIUPP press licensing.

title: July 27 All Over Again
desc: Outlaw Megawati's PDI-P by emergency decree and redistribute its 153 seats across the Assembly.

title: Pruning the Banyan Tree
desc: Disqualify Akbar Tandjung's old-guard Golkar caucus over the Bank Bali election-fraud audit.

title: Back to the Barracks
desc: Abolish ABRI's 38 unelected MPR seats and dismantle the Kodam territorial command structure in a single campaign.

title: End Dwifunsi button
desc: Create a civilian defense ministry, separate POLRI from ABRI, dismantle the Kodam command structure and abolish ABRI's MPR seats. Cilangkap has seen your message and is composing a reply.

title: Non-Negotiable Unity (Terms and Conditions Apply)
desc: Enact regional autonomy, the Aceh special status law and the Maluku–Irian Jaya division. The unitary state is non-negotiable, except for the parts that were negotiated.

title: Menolak Rupa
desc: Commemorate Trisakti and Semanggi, reconcile with Chinatown, found the Women's Commission, review the SBKRI rules, declassify the 1965 files and repeal the Chinese cultural ban.

title: Cendana Cashback
desc: Seize the Cendana toll roads, audit the Kodam foundations and convene the Suharto asset seizure tribunal. Receipts, please.

title: Odd Bedfellows
desc: Win the MPR General Session while PDI-P and Poros Tengah, who have been coordinating against you, both hold 70 or higher loyalty.

title: Halo, Halo Senayan
desc: Work the telephones every night of the finale: use a Final Appeal on both action nights of the finale: the Accountability Speech and the Night of the Long Knives.

title: A Debt of Honor, Carried to the Grave
desc: Hold at least one banked Favor with six different factions at the same time.

title: Red Shirts Aren't Enough
desc: Win the MPR General Session even though PDI-P's Street Mobilization hit 100% and the bloc voted to reject to the last delegate.

title: Coffee First, General?
desc: Win the MPR General Session with the generals neither angry nor alienated. Have some coffee first, General.

title: Pancasila Forever!
desc: Re-impose the 1985 Asas Tunggal law under emergency rule and dissolve the religious party blocs in the MPR.

title: Unify Golkar
desc: Reconcile the two wings of Golkar.

title: The Rainbow Coalition
desc: Proclaim a government of national unity with PDI-P, Golkar, Central Axis, and ABRI.

title: Bhinneka Tunggal Ika
desc: Complete the MPR General Session with PDI-P, Poros Tengah, Golkar (DPP Slipi) and TNI all at 60 or higher loyalty.

title: Bragging Rights
desc: Defend your Accountability Speech in Severe State Situations (SSS) with every situation card set to Level III.
